summary: Completed API and browser testing for the Casefile NCLT workspace. Core template, guided form, validation, preview, generation, persistence, and DOCX/PDF export flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Automated tests require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported in the pytest process; the configured frontend .env is not automatically loaded by pytest.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed generated document through the live API for persistence/export verification; no seed records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workspace, template search, NCLT form validation, preview, optional notes, generation, recent documents, mobile load, and API exports were covered. No auth flow exists or was required.
rca of the issue: The initial pytest invocation failed before making requests because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was absent from the shell environment. Rerunning with the value read from frontend/.env passed all three tests; this is test-run configuration, not an application defect.
